title: Remove and refit the intact clutch release cylinder
completeness: Complete unbolt/refit of the intact stock release cylinder with its hydraulic hose kept attached, new mounting O-ring and verified closure. Pushrod and shaft oil seal remain installed; no bleeding or clutch-internal overhaul claim.

applicability.included: Exact stock 2026 US standard YZ450F; original serviceable assemblies unless explicitly replaced below
excluded: Opening hydraulic joints or piston service
Pushrod removal or shaft oil-seal replacement

prerequisites: Match the exact bike and installed stock parts. Have the complete cited diagrams available.
Stable maintenance stand and support suitable for changing weight distribution; clean labeled parts storage.

required_tools.name: Stable support for bike and release-cylinder body
Appropriate low-range torque wrench covering7–10 N·m
Silicone grease and source-specified LOCTITE threadlocking treatment

required_parts.name: New exact clutch-release-cylinder mounting O-ring
required_parts.purpose: Mounting seal shown new on OEM PDF257; verify OEM part for this exact bike.

critical_stop_conditions: Unstable support, bent/cracked parts, damaged fasteners or unknown assembly order.
Binding, leaks, missing hardware or abnormal brake/control function remains an unresolved fault.

steps.title: Prepare the left-side work area
steps.instruction: Stop the engine, let it cool and support the bike. Clean the drive-sprocket/release-cylinder area. Prevent the clutch lever being operated while the release unit is unbolted. Keep the hose unions and bleed screw untouched.
verification: Cold supported bike; clean work area; clutch lever protected.
steps.origin: Original OEM-based summary; record prompts and sealed-assembly handling are explicit workshop workflow adaptations.

steps.title: Remove the sprocket cover
steps.instruction: Remove the two drive-sprocket-cover bolts and the cover, retaining their locations. Do not remove the sprocket or shift pedal for this bounded operation.
steps.origin: Original OEM-based summary; record prompts and sealed-assembly handling are explicit workshop workflow adaptations.

steps.title: Support and unbolt the release cylinder
steps.instruction: Support the intact release-cylinder body, remove its two mounting bolts and ease it away. Keep the hose attached and unstressed; retain the washer and mounting O-ring. Leave push rod 2 and its installed oil seal in the engine. Do not operate the lever or allow dirt into the exposed area.
verification: Unit supported; hydraulic joints untouched; washer retained; rod and seal undisturbed.
steps.origin: Original OEM-based summary; record prompts and sealed-assembly handling are explicit workshop workflow adaptations.

steps.title: Inspect the mounting interface
steps.instruction: Inspect the cylinder body and accessible mounting surfaces for damage and record the condition. A hydraulic leak, damaged cylinder or disturbed piston requires the separate hydraulic service; this guide only removes/refits the intact unit.
verification: Condition recorded; no hydraulic service implied.
steps.origin: Original OEM-based summary; record prompts and sealed-assembly handling are explicit workshop workflow adaptations.

steps.title: Restore the washer and new mounting seal
steps.instruction: Fit a new correct release-cylinder mounting O-ring, lubricated with silicone grease. Keep the original washer in the illustrated position. Apply silicone grease to the exposed pushrod-end contact and leave the installed rod oil seal undisturbed. Match the source drawing before seating the cylinder.
verification: New lubricated O-ring and original washer correctly located; rod seal undisturbed.
steps.origin: Original OEM-based summary; record prompts and sealed-assembly handling are explicit workshop workflow adaptations.

steps.title: Secure the intact release cylinder
steps.instruction: Seat the cylinder without trapping its O-ring or hose. Apply the source-specified LOCTITE threadlocking treatment to the two mounting bolts and tighten them to 10 N·m. The 5 N·m bleed screw and 30 N·m hose union shown nearby are not mounting bolts and remain untouched.
verification: Two mount bolts 10 N·m with specified threadlocking treatment; hydraulics closed.
steps.origin: Original OEM-based summary; record prompts and sealed-assembly handling are explicit workshop workflow adaptations.

steps.title: Refit the sprocket cover
steps.instruction: Replace the cover and tighten both cover bolts to 7 N·m. Restore original hose routing and clearances without twist.
verification: Cover bolts 7 N·m; hose routed without tension or pinch.
steps.origin: Original OEM-based summary; record prompts and sealed-assembly handling are explicit workshop workflow adaptations.

steps.title: Check clutch operation
steps.instruction: Check normal lever operation and inspect for leakage. Record the work as intact cylinder removal/refit. A soft/spongy lever, leak, moving mount or abnormal clutch function is not a completed repair; use the separate source procedure before riding.
verification: Normal clutch operation and no leakage; findings recorded.
steps.origin: Original OEM-based summary; record prompts and sealed-assembly handling are explicit workshop workflow adaptations.
